description.en:
The source of the project.

-OpenAPI

-AliyunConsole

-WebSDK

Valid values:

- AliyunConsole: The project is created in the Alibaba Cloud console.

- WebSDK: The project is created by using the SDK for Web.

- OpenAPI: The project is created by calling API operations.

description.zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

description.zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh:
剪辑工程类型，默认EditingProject

- EditingProject: 普通剪辑工程

- LiveEditingProject: 直播剪辑工程
description.en:
The type of the editing project. Default value: EditingProject. Valid values:

- EditingProject: a regular editing project.

- LiveEditingProject: a live stream editing project.

description.zh:
结果排序方式。取值范围：

\-CreationTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。

\-CreationTime:Asc：按创建时间升序。
description.en:
The sorting rule of results. Valid values:

\- CreationTime:Desc (default): The results are sorted in reverse chronological order based on the creation time.

\- CreationTime:Asc: The results are sorted in chronological order based on the creation time.

description.zh: CreationTime（创建时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

description.zh:
云剪辑工程状态。多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。默认获取所有云剪辑工程。

取值范围：

\-Draft：草稿。

\-Producing：合成中。

\-Produced：合成成功。

\-ProduceFailed：合成失败。
description.en:
The status of the online editing project. Separate multiple values with commas (,). By default, all online editing projects are queried.

Valid values:

-Draft

-Producing

-Produced

-ProduceFailed

The template type. Valid values:

-Timeline

-VETemplate

Valid values:

- Timeline: regular template.

- VETemplate: advanced template.

- None: No template is used.
